description: Read two original New Zealand procurement notices and saved the verified decision in products/services/nz-gets-offline-delivery/director-two-notice-verdict.json (TASK-179562421612). Health NZ requests a cloud navigation solution. EECA requests specialist biogas research, and its split-response feature separates pricing from other response material. Neither public notice establishes a separately quotable offline deliverable. Reconsider either opportunity if a readable tender document expressly invites that scope and leaves time to respond. The SQLite quote-intake release remains an independent path through exact-digest review. Five feedback sources remain unclassified, so demand is unknown. Treasury remains unfunded with CAD 0 available and no verified revenue.
